_meta.what: Claims the delivered documents must NOT assert, and content they MUST carry. Checked against the RENDERED output, not the source, because a claim survives in places a source grep cannot reach: a JSON data file the build reads, a markdown document it embeds, a table cell assembled at render time, a docstring, a directory name.
_meta.why: Three defects shipped or nearly shipped before this gate existed: the NILC cut asserted in five live documents after the decision was reversed; the retired per-class n_bio printed as a live metric with its correction pages away in the glossary; and the contents page matching its own entries. Each was found by reading the render, none by reading the source.
